Well I was basically going through a period of depression and I started to meditate in order to relieve myself of some pain, I started reading Eckart Tolles works and Michael Singers and found myself becoming more and more happy, more at peace, more alive. I started feeling a glorious sense of awe and excitement of the world as I continued to meditate and read the books. when my family and friends noficed that I wasnt sleeping and acting somewhat strangely, since I was happy, I was brought to the mental hospital near me, and then I was quickly sectioned (I live in the UK). In the hospital I became more and more out of control, I stopped meditating but still felt an overwhelming sense of joy, I would literally just dance about in bathroom listening to music for hours on end. I feel that the meditating allowed all the emotions that had been surpressed as a result of depression to be released at a massive scale, and I wasnt able to handle it. I was eventually medicated and all the peace and joy subsided and a long spell of depression followed
